text:
ana: heads-up — multiple customers reporting silent resume behavior: client resumes stream and sees duplicate final chunk. Repro on SSE and ws-edge.
raj: any sample traces or tenants?
ana: trace=zxy900, trace=zxy904. pattern: runtime sends final chunk, proxy stalls due to backpressure then later sends resume and another final. Client sees completion twice.
liam: could this be our debounce on resume vs backpressure drain? We added 150ms debounce last sprint.
zoe: console shows stream.resume_after_final up 0.14% in last 3h, mostly from eu-north edge. Panel: https://console/redwood/d/streams?panel=resume_dup
ops: edge pool eu-north had recent network flaps; its socket write_queue spiked which affects backpressure heuristics.
raj: two action paths: 1) quick: increase debounce to 300ms in proxy for canary subset (reduces accidental resumes) 2) longer: make resume idempotent at runtime or add final_chunk_id so duplicates are suppressed.
liam: prefer long-term idempotency. We should tag each final frame with frame_id. Then runtime and billing can dedupe.
zoe: telemetry request: add span tag final_frame_id and metric stream.duplicate_final_by_route. Also add counter stream.resume_debounce_trigger and sample trace ids.
ops: quick canary sounds low-risk. We'll flip proxy.resume_debounce_ms=300 for 5% traffic. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 75% with rollback if resume_dup > +50% vs baseline or 5xx > 10%.
telemetry-bot: note: create alert: stream.duplicate_final_rate > 0.05% over 10m -> pager to eng-platform-oncall.
ana: customers are sensitive about billing; duplicates cause replays and double charging. Billing team: can we do temporary dedupe for completions that share final_frame_id or same trace within 1s?
liam: billing cannot rely on frame_id until we roll protocol change. But we can implement short window dedupe by trace id. Ops: feasible?
ops: yes, we can add a 1s idempotency window keyed by trace id in billing service as a guard. Will need risk review for perf.
raj: also add console UX: show attempted_resume_count next to route SLOs and annotate canary lanes. zoe: will add panel tiles.
zoe: I'll add a canary dashboard comparing control vs variant (resume_debounce_ms) and billing delta estimate. Also add top sample traces for manual triage.
liam: RFC: frame_id header X-Redwood-Final-Id, set by runtime for final chunk; proxy preserves and logs it. We'll use it for dedupe later. I'll draft.
ana: plan summary: ops do canary debounce bump, zoe dashboards/alerts, liam frame_id RFC, ops add billing short-window dedupe, raj coordinate canary monitor.
ops: PR queued CH-11011, canary starting 02:30 UTC, eval window 20m. rollback triggers set.
zoe: acked. I'll watch panels and tag traces rollout.variant=debounce-300.
liam: small customer note: recommend clients tolerate brief reconnects and rely on resume semantics. We'll publish a short FAQ.
ana: thanks all. We'll reconvene in 30m after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
ops: ack
